title: lathyrus vestitus subsp. laetiflorus
intro: Lathyrus vestitus subsp. laetiflorus, commonly known as the Western sweet pea, is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. It is a flowering legume known for its attractive, fragrant flowers and edible seeds. The Western sweet pea has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues and digestive problems, due to its health benefits which include anti-inflammatory, antispasmodic, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents of Lathyrus vestitus subsp. laetiflorus include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as soothing coughs and relieving pain.
